newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordbanken buy-back to add to Swedish state coffer.
newsitem.headline: Nordbanken buy-back to add to Swedish state coffer.

text.p: The Swedish state said on Wednesday it would receive at most five billion crowns and at least 3.275 billion crowns from the proposed five billion crown buy-back by state-controlled bank Nordbanken.
"If the state accounts for the entire buy-back it will mean five billion crowns at the most," Hans Jacobson, finance department director, told Reuters.
"If all the other shareholders join in, it means we will also participate with our share of 65.5 percent, which means we will receive 3.275 billion crowns," he said.
Jacobson said the money would be added to the state budget.
"Thereby, the state's borrowing requirement will be reduced," he said but did not say by how much.
Sweden's Nordbanken on Wednesday proposed a five billion crown share buy-back that could reduce the government's holding to 58 percent from 65.5 percent.
